upperFace.description: Brows, forehead, upper eyelids. Idle provides base; affect drives expressions; cognitive adds brow modifiers; events add pulses.

lowerFace.description: Mouth shapes, cheeks, jaw area. Idle base; affect drives mouth corners/expressions; events add pulses; speech owns jaw/mouth while speaking (scales affect to 30%).

eyes.description: Eye gaze, blinks, eye bones. Idle base; affect drives lids/squint; cognitive drives gaze/look-at; events add wide/surprise; speech may drive blinks. Gesture never writes face shapes (eyeL/eyeR are bones but driven by look-at/cognitive).

jaw.description: Jaw open/forward/left/right. Idle base; affect for tension; speech owns while speaking.

head.description: Head bone rotation. Idle base; affect for posture; cognitive for head tilt/look-at; gesture through mask only.

body.description: Spine, chest, neck. Idle provides breathing/weight shift; affect for posture openness; gesture through mask only.

arms.description: Shoulders, arms, hands. Idle provides hand settle; gesture owns during clips. Gesture never writes face shapes.
